title: SEC Chair Paul Atkins Denies CFTC Merger: “We’re Working Hand In Glove”
summary: Paul Atkins has denied that the SEC and CFTC will merge, saying the agencies have worked closely and favor compartmentalized roles. A Sept. 29 joint roundtable has been scheduled to discuss regulatory harmonization and how both regulators have approached digital-asset oversight. title: Court Denies Justin Sun’s Attempt to Stop Bloomberg from Revealing His $3B+ Crypto Portfolio
summary: The U.S. District Court in Delaware has rejected Justin Sun's injunction request; Bloomberg has continued reporting his crypto holdings. The judge has ruled no confidentiality promise was proven and has noted Sun’s own posts on TRX, BTC, ETH, and USDT undermined privacy and risk claims.
